_readme: Coordinates used by (1) the mock NIPOST in NIPOST_MODE=mock and (2) the rider page's 'Simulated location' switch.
The coordinates below are PLACEHOLDERS, not the real positions of these buildings.
Before demo day, replace them with coordinates that reverse-geocode to each postcode on NIPOST staging
(ask NIPOST onboarding, or use the widget's map mode), then run scripts/smoke-test.sh in live mode.
The 'address' strings are what the mock geocoder (GEOCODER_MODE=mock) can find on the /find/ page.

locations.address: Demo customer home, Mock Street, Lagos
